Introduced the Low Blow Skill Perk: Ranged attacks that hit the enemy in the legs (lower third of the body or their legs) applies "Hamstrung" which reduces enemy movement speed for a short while. Tiny and Colossal Enemies are immune.

Fixed an issue where the Blue Dragon would take inaccurate damage when fought from different heights.
Fixed an issue where luring the Black Dragon to a safespot would cause performance drops on some hardware.
Resolved an issue where Velgar's Poison Breath attack had misaligned VFX on PS5 systems.
Fixed an issue where light was emitted from the final puzzle before Kuldra as if they were active when they weren't.
Fixed an issue where ores would respawn instantly when teleporting in the Scorned Wilderness raid. Nice try.

Fixed an issue where Fuzan would briefly appear to get back up before dying for real this time.
Resolved an issue where controller action direction fails to affect blocking input.

Parrying will now restore 50% of your max stamina allowing you to quickly turn the tide with a burst of energy if you time it correctly - increasing the risk/reward of timing it just right.

0.9 is dropping on September 9th, including Custom World Sliders, Creative Mode and, of course, the Ranged Skill Tree. We're talking new weapons, new skill spells, and rewards for grinding through those levels. Let's get stuck into what's on the menu:
So, we got thinking - what could a hunter use to prevent their prey, or their enemy from moving - either too close, or too far? Snare is our solution to that problem.

Snare can be cast to mark an area of the ground that will trigger when an enemy moves into it. Upon triggering, the spell will entangle the target in roots, pinning them in place, and leaving them vulnerable to any and all forms of attack.

The Snares that you place now trigger a cloud of damaging poison when activated, causing enemies stuck inside to become poisoned over time. Once poisoned, enemies will continue to take poison damage even once the trap subsides.

When you draw your arrows, you will see a particular glint at the tip of the arrow that may catch your eye. We've introduced "Trick Shots", a system that lets you get into a rhythm when firing your arrows. This will let you capitalise on hitting a particular rhythm when shooting that grants you an additional damage boost when you shoot, to keep up a more consistent, higher-damage output that rewar

As you progress through your Ranged skill tree, you'll unlock the ability to brew new potions at the Brewing Cauldron using the new herb: Kwuarm. Brew this with a Poison Ichor to create - you guessed it - Weapon Poison. Use this on a melee weapon to poison your blade, or create Poison Arrows. You can finally poison enemies back. Give them a taste of their own medicine!

Then, there are Weapon Barbs - brutal spikes to rend your foes with every swing, stab or shot. Use these to create Barbed arrows, that apply stacks of bleed damage. Then there are also Fire arrows, which trigger (you'll never have guessed this) fire damage! Experiment with the builds, stack up DPS and turn those pesky Garou into pincushions!

The passive ability of the Ranged Skill Tree will be a chance to be able to retrieve your arrows from an enemy's body once they die.
